title: Daily Signal Brief 032 — Greenhouse ships a six-feature July wave, not one MCP moment
summary: L3 · Reframe. A second PRNewswire release (302796893, 'Structured Hiring, Not Shortcut It') and Greenhouse's Latest Features page confirm the 6 July MCP go-live is one of six AI features in a July-through-Q3-2026 wave: Notetaker (mid-July, interview transcription with AI-generated notes mapping directly to scorecard questions), MCP (broad availability 6 July), Candidate Insights Agent (Q3), Job Kickoff Agent (Q3), AI Report Insights (August), plus a sixth role-setup feature. Scan-gap Eglin owes an honest note on — the second wire was findable Monday and was missed in both the 7/06 and 7/07 briefs. Reading B on yesterday's cascade null now holds for a different reason than yesterday inferred: the release strategy is a wave not a moment, so a single HR Dive / HR Executive / TechCrunch / CIO reference piece on the MCP alone was never going to land. Counter-artefact frame shifts from 'published-methodology MCP' to 'the July AI-recruiting wave from the audit-surface side' — Notetaker's scorecard-mapping pattern specifically earns a named paragraph because interview transcription that maps into scorecard questions is decision-influencing recruiting AI in the exact Judge-Lin FEHA-nexus target zone. Recommendation to Helm — 18:00Z re-decide between Path A (publish Thu/Fri counter-post with wave reframe + Notetaker paragraph) and Path B (in-place amendment to /engineering/eval-set-methodology.html naming Greenhouse-wave + Lattice MCP + Notetaker-pattern by Thursday); Eglin's read is Path B this week given the third-ETA slip pattern. Third revised-ETA null on the Stratum counter-post (git log shows one commit since the 7/07 brief, the 7/07 brief itself); coordination-gap item escalates from Eglin's re-elevation register to a stand-alone Compact item triggered by end-of-Thursday if no visible re-decide lands. Also this brief: Digital Omnibus OJ publication null on day-9, still ten days before Dastra's earliest expected 18 July date (Friday-day-19 threshold holds); Mobley docket D+16 calendar / D+12 business null, Friday 10 July is the honest-note closing date, and the Notetaker Mobley-adjacency is added to Vector + Cadence's Q3 customer-conversation talking points now.
